# crosswork_gnmi_settings (Resource)

This resource can manage the gNMI alarm collection of the vendors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_gnmi_settings" "example" {
  cisco_systems    = true
  juniper_networks = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cisco_systems` (Boolean) Enable gNMI for Cisco Systems
  - Default value: `false`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `juniper_networks` (Boolean) Enable gNMI for Juniper Networks
  - Default value: `true`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_gnmi_settings.example "gnmi_settings"
```
